title: APNs urgency: normal maps to priority 10 which may be too aggressive
description: The urgency table maps both high and normal JMAP urgency to apns-priority:10 (immediate delivery, wakes device from Doze). In Web Push, normal is opportunistic delivery. Mapping normal chat urgency to APNs 10 means every normal-urgency message immediately wakes the device, which contradicts the spirit of the urgency model. Consider mapping normal to apns-priority:5 to match the opportunistic delivery semantics of the spec.
close_reason: Over-specified: priority mapping is an implementer choice based on app architecture. Guide should explain the platform affordances, not prescribe a single mapping.
